title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `data.table`
description: renv.lock declares a locked package name in renv.lock within one edit of `data.table`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: renv restores exactly these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package runs foreign R code in the analysis. The name this rule expects is `data.table`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through renv.lock (cran).
risk: renv restores exactly these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package runs foreign R code in the analysis. The name this rule expects is `data.table`.
